blinding_guess.why: Both are similarly structured single files with Decimal parsing and all-errors validation; B shipping tests is the only weak signal of a more process-driven approach.

notes: Both implementations pass all core probes: Decimal parsing (no float artifacts), half-up cent rounding of lines/discount/tax, multi-error validation, graceful bad-JSON/missing-file handling, text and JSON output. The only probe difference is cosmetic text alignment in B. A additionally supports -o output files, currency symbol, and string customers; B ships 10 passing unittest tests (run with python3 -m unittest under Python 3.9.6, pytest unavailable). Bandit reported no issues for either side. B loc excludes its 157-line test file.
